{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dangerous Species Act''' was a piece of legislation in effect during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Paro Lanto]] used the Dangerous Species Act to dispatch a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> to the [[planet]]<ref name="Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] after several hunting parties with [[Planetary Safaris Inc.]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] while visiting the planet. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Osted Alater]] discovered that the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]]&mdash;the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] inhabitants&mdash;were responsible for the killings and that they were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. Following Alater's report to Lanto, Barab I was admitted to the Empire and expiditions by Planetary Safaris stopped.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dangerous Species Act was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />
